page_title: AI Receptionist That Never Misses a Call, 24/7 | Twig

sources.entry: Twig - Twig is an AI assistant that resolves customer issues instantly, supporting both users and support agents 24/7.

summary.name: Twig (Sera AI receptionist)
summary.one_liner: Twig offers Sera, an AI receptionist that answers calls, texts and web chats 24/7, qualifies callers and books appointments.
use_cases: answer after-hours calls and book appointments
recover missed calls with automatic text-back
qualify new insurance or mortgage leads
answer website chat questions from visitors
hand off complex calls to a human team
summary.what_it_does: Sera answers phone calls, texts and website chats around the clock, answers customer questions from the business's content, and qualifies callers. She books appointments onto the business calendar and can send follow-up texts such as new-patient forms. When she cannot answer a question, the page says she takes the details and hands off to the team with the full conversation. The page includes a missed-revenue estimator where users enter their own call and conversion numbers. Setup is described as pasting a website and forwarding a phone line.
notable: Answers phone, text and chat 24/7 and books appointments on the calendar
Missed-call text-back, live transfers and human handoff on Growth and above
Plans from $49/mo with a 15-day free trial and no credit card
Industry pages for insurance agencies, dental practices, mortgage lenders and B2B SaaS
caveats: Growth plan at $499/mo is needed for booking, missed-call recovery, live transfers and multi-language support
Revenue recovery figures are an estimate, not a guarantee
Sera does not quote premiums, bind coverage, quote rates or terms, per the industry examples
